name: natives
description: Natives — Chromium 文件管理扩展与 Rust Native Host

scripts.perf:files: npm run extension:check && node scripts/perf/architecture-check.mjs && npm run perf:extension && npm run perf:extension:test && npm run perf:native-host
scripts.extension:check: node extension/check-syntax.mjs && node extension/files-session.test.mjs && node extension/native-client.test.mjs && node extension/plugins-cache.test.mjs && node extension/space-modals.test.mjs && node extension/space-plugins-smoke.test.mjs && node extension/space-deep-verify.test.mjs && node extension/space-inspector.test.mjs && node extension/space.test.mjs && node extension/check-lifecycle.mjs && node extension/dev.mjs --self-test
scripts.extension:host:build: rtk env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo build -p native-file-host
scripts.extension:host:build:release: rtk env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo build -p native-file-host --release
scripts.extension:release: npm run extension:host:build:release && npm run extension:check && npm run perf:files
